notes.title: Visual for Reload Region
notes.notes: An update (v1.1.0.23) has been deployed that will display a yellow gradient when the user has the cursor in the reload region at the top of the screen. Thanks again for your feedback!

notes.title: New Reload Option
notes.notes: Thanks to community feedback, an update has been deployed for Cytoclash (v1.1.0.22) that includes a new reloading mechanic. In addition to the existing reload slider at the bottom of the screen, the player can click towards the top portion of the screen to trigger a reload. This should better align with typical lightgun game reloading and allow better functionality with PC lightgun accessories.
